name: Freemasons
overview: Scripture uses imagery of builders and carpenters to illustrate spiritual truths, such as the rejected stone becoming the cornerstone, highlighting God's sovereign plan beyond human design (Psalms 118:22; Isaiah 44:13). Jesus emphasizes sincerity and openness in faith, warning against secretive or showy righteousness (Matthew 6:1; John 18:20), and declares Himself as the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6). These verses caution believers to trust in Christ alone rather than human traditions or secret knowledge, reminding us that true spiritual foundation comes from God, not from human-crafted systems or symbols.
